class.name: DisRemoveEntityPdu
class.brief_description: Remove Entity PDU (type 12): asks an application to remove an entity.
class.description: A Remove Entity PDU asks the application that owns [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.receiving_id] to remove that entity from the exercise. It has no fields of its own beyond those of [DisSimulationManagementPdu] and is 28 bytes long. The receiver answers with a [DisAcknowledgePdu] carrying the same [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id].

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Remove Entity PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Remove Entity PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 28 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].
